_source.title: 定位到画布坐标
_source.remarks.text.0: 本接口在前端画布上定位到指定的数据层面坐标；
_source.remarks.text.1:
如果希望在进行本操作时前端画布坐标能与传入数据一致，
建议调用 {@link PCB_Document.setCanvasOrigin} 方法并设置偏移量为零；
_source.remarks.text.2: 此处的单位为数据层面单位，在跨度上等同于画布层面的 mil
_source.example.text.0: 1. 创建测试 PCB 并打开（视口操作作用于当前激活的 PCB）

title: Locate to canvas coordinate
remarks.text.0: This API positions on the front-end canvas to the specified data-level coordinate;
remarks.text.1:
If you want the front-end canvas coordinate to be consistent with the passed-in data during this operation,
it is recommended to call the {@link PCB_Document.setCanvasOrigin} method and set the offset to zero;
remarks.text.2: The units here are data-level units, which are equivalent to mil on the canvas level in span
